visual_brief: Khan Tengri is a steep marble pyramid above the Inylchek glaciers. Classic views show its snowy southern pyramid or darker, ribbed north face glowing gold at sunset. Distinguish it from nearby Chapaev, which can appear taller from northern viewpoints, and the broader Pobeda massif.
notes: Six distinct photographs downloaded and visually checked. Prefer c1 or c2. All meet the 1600-pixel long-side minimum; five exceed 2400 pixels. Reference image untouched.
